lines.en: I hop along on two legs.

lines.zh: 箱盖一张一合，像在呼吸。
lines.en: My lid opens and shuts like breathing.

lines.zh: 我拖着箱子底下那一截腿。
lines.en: I trail the legs beneath my box.
One hop and the ground knocks.
I hop toward you.
This box is heavy; I hop slowly.

lines.zh: 我从宝箱的样子变成现在这样。
lines.en: I've gone from a chest to this.

lines.zh: 我绕过一块石头，很笨重。
lines.en: I lumber around a stone.
My tongue moves inside.
Three hops and I'm there.

lines.zh: 我的盖子边缘一直在咬。
lines.en: The rim of my lid keeps biting.

lines.zh: 我一路跳过去，砸出小坑。
lines.en: I hop along, leaving small pits.

lines.zh: 我合上盖子，像一只箱子。
lines.en: I close my lid and look like a chest.
I stay still and wait for you to come.
The grain on the box is real.
A faint gleam shows under my lid.
I tuck my legs underneath.
I open a thin crack.

lines.zh: 箱子一动不动，等一个影子。
lines.en: The chest lies still, waiting for a shadow.
Nobody comes here.
My lock has long broken.
I raise the lid a little.
You crouch to look at the chest.
I count the moment you reach out.
My lid shifts.
You think this is a treasure chest.
Look at that seam on the chest.
Half a step more and the lid opens.
I count three on your hovering hand.
I'm all teeth inside.
You've backed off, too late.
I'm done pretending.

lines.zh: 我的盖子歪了，合不严实。
lines.en: My lid is crooked and won't shut properly.
I hop off a stretch and bounce back.
A crack has opened in my box.

lines.zh: 我把盖子闭上，护住里面。
lines.en: I shut the lid to guard what's inside.
A muffled groan squeezes between my boards.

lines.zh: 箱子底下伸出的小腿在抖。
lines.en: The little legs beneath my chest tremble.
Blood seeps between the boards.
I settle low like an empty chest.
I can hop a few more times.
I open my lid slowly.
I'll eat that.
The chest moves by itself.
I open the lid all the way.

lines.zh: 我连箱子带东西一起吞。
lines.en: I swallow the goods with the box.
It's smaller than I thought.
My tongue goes out first.
Not even enough to fill a gap in my teeth.

lines.zh: 我用舌头把战利品拖进盖子。
lines.en: My tongue drags the loot under the lid.
Can you hear the chewing inside.
That wouldn't wedge my teeth.

lines.zh: 你撞到箱子上，箱子动了。
lines.en: You hit the chest and it moves.

lines.zh: 我的盖子被撞得弹起来。
lines.en: The knock throws my lid open.
I hop back a stretch and return.

lines.zh: 这一下让我的箱子凹了。
lines.en: That dents my box.

lines.zh: 箱子一歪，我滑到旁边去了。
lines.en: The chest tips and I slide aside.
The box hits the ground loudly.
My legs show a little.
I press the lid shut.
I stop playing dead.
I hop back in front of you.
Two chests stand side by side.
Her box is older than mine.
We open our lids and look at each other.
Our teeth click together.
She stops pretending, and so do I.
We hop twice together.
Her legs are thicker than mine.
We close our lids.
We split this area.
She turns back into a chest.

lines.zh: 我把盖子一合，东西在里面。
lines.en: I shut the lid; it's inside now.
I swallow the dirt with it.
It's caught in the seam of my lid.
My tongue draws it in.

lines.zh: 这点重量我背着无所谓。
lines.en: Its weight means nothing to me.
It rattles inside me.
I bite once; it's stone.

lines.zh: 石头硌着了，我吐到箱外。
lines.en: The stone jabs me, so I spit it out.
I'll keep it as bait.
I close the lid again.

lines.zh: 你的脚正踩在我影子里。
lines.en: Your feet are already in my shadow.

lines.zh: 我的盖子自己抬了起来。
lines.en: My lid rises by itself.
I'm not a chest anymore.
I hop at you, one hop at a time.
You can't back out of this.
All my teeth are bared.
I bite from behind you.
You're still looking somewhere else.
I waited the whole afternoon.
Now it's time to collect.
I pin your foot.
One step of yours, two hops of mine.
My lid aims at you and every tooth wakes.
You've backed to the wall.

lines.zh: 我一点一点把盖子掀开。
lines.en: I lift my lid a little at a time.
It's dark in here, isn't it.
I'm biting down now.
Once I bite, there is no next time.

lines.zh: 我一跳一跳，箱子撞着地板。
lines.en: I hop, and the chest thumps the floor.
You look away and I speed up.
Your feet are dragging now.
I hop ahead and cut you off.
A chest stands in your way.
You'd better not open it.

lines.zh: 我的盖缝里透出一点光。
lines.en: A little light shows between my lid and box.
You've fallen for it.
I leap and come down on you.
You're right under my lid.
I close it little by little.
Both rows of teeth come together.
You're struggling hard inside.

lines.zh: 我等你把手伸得更近些。
lines.en: I wait for your hand to come closer.

lines.zh: 不会有人来开这只箱子。
lines.en: No one will come to open this chest.
Your struggle has grown lighter.

lines.zh: 你在里面喊，我当没听见。
lines.en: You shout inside me and I pretend not to hear.
My lid closes another finger's width.
This is the last one.
This is where it ends.
I slam the lid down.
Both rows of teeth close.
I leap and come down on you.
You hold the lid; I press harder.
My tongue wraps your leg.
This bite lands on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你打在我的箱子上，没用。
lines.en: You hit the box; it does nothing.
I open the lid again.
I tip you over with the corner of my lid.
You're driven against the box.
I've snapped the lid three times.
Your armor breaks in my mouth.

lines.zh: 箱子落在你背上，压住了。
lines.en: The chest lands on your back and pins you.
No matter how you shake, you can't throw me off.

lines.zh: 第二口咬在原来的牙印上。
lines.en: My second bite lands on the same mark.
I grind slowly; you will give.
Two bites in quick succession.
I drag you toward the box.
My teeth close on your back.
I hold you down.
A chest appears on the roadside.
Its lock is broken.
The wood grain looks new.

lines.zh: 箱子缝里透出一点微光。
lines.en: A faint gleam shows through the chest's seam.
Footsteps are coming closer.
I close my lid tighter.
I shift my position.
This looks exactly like a treasure chest.
My legs are hidden underneath.
I wait for that person to reach out.
I only need them to crouch down.
I set myself somewhere obvious.

lines.zh: 木头烧起来了，我蹦着躲。
lines.en: My wood catches fire and I hop away.

lines.zh: 我摔在地上，箱子散了半边。
lines.en: I hit the ground and half the box breaks.

lines.zh: 水灌进箱子里，我合不上盖。
lines.en: Water pours in and I can't shut the lid.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我的盖子掀飞了。
lines.en: The blast blows my lid off.
An arrow sticks in my board.

lines.zh: 那道光让我的盖子卡住了。
lines.en: The light jams my lid.

lines.zh: 没东西吃，箱子沉得像石头。
lines.en: Nothing to eat; my chest feels like stone.

lines.zh: 雷打在箱子上，木头冒烟。
lines.en: Lightning hits the box and the wood smokes.
No ground below; I keep falling.
